description: This file defines the RegistrationMessageFilter class, which verifies the format and required properties of registration messages in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: RegistrationMessageFilter
classes.description: A final class extending BaseMessageFilter that provides a static method to verify registration messages' properties.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Checks whether a registration message contains all required properties, including device ID, correlation ID, subject, and reply-to address.
